name: Muhammad Nabil Al Qadri
heroDescription: Bridging the gap between scalable software architecture and artificial intelligence to build high-performance, data-driven enterprise solutions.
about: Three projects I worked on pair a trained model with a web app: chest X-ray TB detection, fake news classification and face-recognition attendance. Outside class I have attended sessions on Generative AI, threat modelling and Golang microservices at the School of Computer Science & DSAI.
aboutId: Tiga proyek yang saya kerjakan memadukan model terlatih dengan aplikasi web: deteksi TB dari X-ray dada, klasifikasi berita palsu, dan presensi berbasis pengenalan wajah. Di luar kelas, saya mengikuti sesi Generative AI, threat modelling, dan microservices Golang di School of Computer Science & DSAI.
